items.prompt: A baker makes 6 trays of 24 muffins. He sells 97 muffins in the morning. How many muffins are left?
Sara has 3 boxes with 15 pencils each. She gives 8 pencils to her friend. How many pencils does she have now?
A train travels 60 miles per hour for 2.5 hours. How many miles does it travel?
Tom buys 4 notebooks at 3 dollars each and a pen for 2 dollars. He pays with a 20 dollar bill. How much change does he get, in dollars?
A rectangle is 9 cm long and 4 cm wide. What is its area in square centimeters?
There are 128 students and 8 classes. If each class has the same number of students, how many students are in each class?
A water tank holds 500 liters. 35 percent of the water is used. How many liters remain?
Jake reads 12 pages per day. How many days will it take him to read a 204-page book?
A shirt originally costs 48 dollars. It is discounted by 25 percent. What is the sale price in dollars?
Maria runs 5 km in 30 minutes. At the same pace, how many minutes will it take her to run 12.5 km?
A gardener plants 7 rows of 13 tomato plants. 11 plants die. How many plants survive?
Two numbers add up to 41. One number is 17. What is the other number multiplied by 3?

scoring: The last number in the model output must equal the expected answer.
system: You are a helpful assistant. Answer with just the number.
